title: Zakanzula Group Ignites the Stage at Amrutvahini College
content: Our academic extracurricular journey at Amrutvahini College reached new heights as the Zakanzula Dance Group delivered a powerful performance that lit up the stage. With rhythm, energy, and passion, we connected deeply with the audience—receiving overwhelming cheers and support that made the moment unforgettable. This performance was not just about dance, but about unity, creativity, and the spirit of our college community.
